chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from al-'Umarki, from 'Ali ibn Ja'far, from Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who performs salat (prayer) while a lamp is placed before him in the direction of the qiblah. He said: It is not proper for him to face fire.

key_terms.السِّرَاجُ: a lamp placed with a visible flame
key_terms.لَا يَصْلُحُ: it is not proper or fitting

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while facing a lamp or fire in the qiblah direction?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer), indicating that one should not pray while facing fire in the direction of the qiblah. It reflects the etiquette and proper form of worship in order to avoid an unsuitable posture during prayer.
